answer: A whisper-gated agent economy hides new identities behind a behavioral pulse. Sentinel peers on separate knolls of the network graph listen to each agent's whisper channel, a low-bandwidth heartbeat of signed micro-decisions, and grant trading rights only after weeks of uninterrupted, causally consistent pulses. Forging a pulse requires replaying unique round-trip-verified decisions in real time, so history cannot be compressed. A thousand fake agents means a thousand parallel whisper streams at full compute: attack cost scales linearly while honest agents pay almost nothing.
